solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: How migrating birds fly shows intelligence

definitions.meaning: geese and other migrants travel in a V shape, flying in an ordered pattern as a group
news or ..., as in military or secret intelligence

explanation.surface: A naturalist claims the way flocks travel reveals how clever birds are.
explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer as IN FORMATION for the first sense: migrating flocks hold a fixed V pattern.
explanation.definitionFit: Intelligence in the sense of gathered news or reports is a synonym.

clue.text: Back-to-back rejections this time

parts.note: a no is a rejection or refusal

indicators.note: two copies set back to back, so the second is read the other way round

explanation.surface: Two refusals in a row, delivered right now.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Back-to-back' sets two NOs spine to spine: the second is turned round to ON.
explanation.definitionFit: Midday is a time of day; 'this time' is a pointing phrase standing for the hour of twelve.

clue.text: Man flipping won't change!

indicators.note: turning the name end to end leaves its letters exactly the same, a palindrome

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A stubborn man insists that, however he flips, he won't change.
explanation.definitionFit: Otto is a man's given name, so a man is the defining example.

clue.text: Metal drawers

parts.note: looks like a chest of steel drawers, but means things that draw (attract) metal

explanation.definitionFit: Lodestones pull iron towards them, so they are drawers of metal in the sense of attractors.

clue.text: Thoughts Hugh dismissed. They're infantile

indicators.note: the letters of the name Hugh are sent away from the word thoughts, one by one in order

explanation.surface: Hugh's ideas are written off as childish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dismissed' removes H, U, G, H scattered through THOUGHTS, leaving T, O, T, S.
explanation.definitionFit: Small children are infants, so they are literally infantile.

clue.text: Surpass in open-work

parts.note: overt means open, not concealed
OP is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: Someone excels at openwork, a lacy decorative craft.
explanation.walkthrough: 'open-work' looks like one craft word but splits into its two halves.
explanation.definitionFit: To rise higher than something is to surpass it.

clue.text: Bit of a character

definitions.meaning: a bit is a portion or piece
an actor's role in a play

explanation.definitionFit: A portion of something, and also an acting role, are both senses of the word.

clue.text: What told builder if someone had been at his whisky?

definitions.text: What told builder if someone had been at his whisky?

parts.words: What told builder if someone had been at his whisky?
parts.note: a builder's levelling tool, read as the height of his bottle of spirits

explanation.definitionFit: The builder's bubble gauge is named for the alcohol in its tube, which the clue reads as a whisky line.

clue.text: Does one grumble when caught?

parts.note: a freshwater fish hooked by anglers whose name is also a verb for complaining

explanation.definitionFit: The fish shares its name with the verb for complaining, so one might wonder if it moans when landed.

clue.text: Met and managed to win the girl

parts.note: if you got to do something, you managed to do it
to get is to win or obtain
her refers to a girl

explanation.surface: He met her and succeeded in winning her heart.
explanation.definitionFit: Getting together means meeting up, a synonym for met.

clue.text: Gentleman given time in prison

indicators.note: the time letter goes in the middle of the gentleman's title

parts.note: sir is the address for a gentleman

explanation.surface: A gentleman is sentenced to a spell behind bars.
explanation.definitionFit: Stir is old underworld slang for a jail or a spell inside, a slang synonym.

clue.text: Smutty jokes?

parts.note: smut is also soot, so jokes coloured by soot are dark-coloured comedy

explanation.definitionFit: Dark comedy about grim subjects is called by a colour, and soot (smut) is that colour.

clue.text: Was clearly pleased with vehicle holding road

indicators.note: the vehicle surrounds the road

parts.note: a sled is a vehicle on runners
the M1 is a motorway, written MI in crosswords

explanation.surface: Someone happy with a car that grips the road.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is Britain's main north-south motorway, its 1 read as letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: Showing pleasure on one's face is to beam or grin.

clue.text: Feels sorry for chaps — last flings over

indicators.note: the letters are flung about and turned over into a new order

parts.note: men are chaps

explanation.surface: Someone regrets the men's final romantic flings.
explanation.definitionFit: To bewail or regret something is to mourn it, a synonym of feeling sorry.

clue.text: Takes the lead member of crew aboard

definitions.note: the leading players of a show, its headliners

indicators.note: the ship word takes the sailor inside it

parts.note: on board ship reads as within SS, the steamship abbreviation
a tar is a sailor

explanation.surface: A crew member comes aboard and assumes command.
explanation.walkthrough: 'aboard' supplies SS, steamship, as on board means in SS; 'Takes' has the ship take in the sailor.
explanation.definitionFit: The headline performers of a film or play take its leading roles.

clue.text: In substance, not dissatisfied

definitions.meaning: the material or matter of something

explanation.definitionFit: The noun stressed on the first syllable means matter; the adjective stressed on the second means satisfied.

clue.text: Part spruce, darling, it's coniferous

indicators.note: only a portion of the words is taken, the run spanning their join

explanation.surface: Telling a darling that a spruce is a conifer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Part' signals the answer sits inside spruCE DARling.
explanation.definitionFit: A tree that bears cones, like the cedar of Lebanon.

clue.text: Allow men when figure's gone to get fit

indicators.note: the numeral has left the word men

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand
able means fit, capable

explanation.surface: Letting men get fit once their figures have slimmed.
explanation.definitionFit: To permit or make possible is to allow.

clue.text: Outside tap's beginning to trickle and soak

indicators.note: the trickle word goes around the tap's letter

parts.note: to seep is to trickle

indicators.note: the first letter of the tap

explanation.surface: Water from an outdoor tap starts trickling and soaks things.
explanation.definitionFit: To immerse in liquid, as tea is left to brew.

clue.text: Name and number must appear on everything

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
all means everything

explanation.surface: A form insists your name and number go on every page.
explanation.definitionFit: To call someone something is to name them.

clue.text: Give a hoot for vehicle on one's right-hand side

parts.note: a car

indicators.note: the last letter, at the right end of the word

explanation.surface: Hooting at a car on the right side of the road.
explanation.definitionFit: Not giving a hoot means not caring, so to give one is to be concerned.

clue.text: Holding a three-fifty examination

indicators.note: the three-fifty letters hold the A inside

parts.note: tri- is the prefix for three
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A test for someone holding three hundred and fifty, perhaps a gun calibre.
explanation.definitionFit: A court hearing or test is an examination.

clue.text: Lit up, having had rum cocktail nothing to eat: chaos

indicators.note: the mixed letters take in the nothing
a cocktail is a mixture, so the letters are mixed up

parts.note: O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Drunk on a rum cocktail with no food, someone is in disarray.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cocktail' mixes LIT and RUM into TURMIL, which 'to eat' takes O into.
explanation.definitionFit: Great disorder or confusion is a synonym for chaos.

clue.text: It restrains prisoners — one girl goes free

indicators.note: the letters are set loose into a new order

explanation.surface: A girl escapes despite the shackles.
explanation.definitionFit: A shackle round the ankle restrains a prisoner.

clue.text: Like something abominable being house-broken, I had sheltered within

indicators.note: the contraction is kept inside the rearranged letters
the house is broken up into a new order

parts.note: I'd is the contraction of I had

explanation.surface: A grim house-training disaster, like the Abominable Snowman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'house-broken' looks like house-trained, but 'broken' rearranges the house, and 'sheltered within' puts I'd inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Something abominable is ugly and repulsive, so it is frightful.

clue.text: Turn clergyman against love, that's ridiculous

parts.note: Rev is short for Reverend, a clergyman

indicators.note: the word love is made nonsense of, rearranged

explanation.surface: A clergyman is turned against love as absurd.
explanation.definitionFit: To spin or rotate is to turn.

clue.text: I caught myself protecting little creatures

indicators.note: the self word wraps protectively around the other letters

parts.note: me is myself
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: Someone shielding small animals they trapped.
explanation.definitionFit: Small rodents are little creatures.

clue.text: Point to fish's secret language

indicators.note: the compass point is added to the end of the fish

parts.note: cod is a fish
E, east, is a compass point

explanation.surface: Pointing to fishes' hidden way of talking.
explanation.definitionFit: A cipher is a secret language.

clue.text: Swear there will be a victory. Next ball: wicket!

parts.note: O is round like a ball
W is the cricket abbreviation for wicket

explanation.surface: A cricketer vows victory: the next ball takes a wicket.
explanation.definitionFit: To vow or declare solemnly is to swear.

clue.text: Lies down, half cut at Back Beach

indicators.note: each word loses its back half, so only its front half is kept

explanation.surface: Someone lies down, half-drunk, at Back Beach.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half cut' looks like tipsy; LIes and DOwn keep their first halves. A lido is a public pool or bathing beach.
explanation.definitionFit: A bathing place or resort beach, from the Lido at Venice.

clue.text: Prompt pocketing coin for tip

indicators.note: the prompt word takes the coin into itself

parts.note: a cue prompts an actor
L stands for pound, a coin

explanation.surface: Someone prompting a waiter, pocketing a coin as a gratuity.
explanation.definitionFit: A hint is a tip, as in a tip-off.

clue.text: Car to suit missionary?

definitions.meaning: a car whose roof folds down
able to be won over, as a missionary would wish

explanation.definitionFit: A soft-top automobile, and also capable of conversion, which a missionary seeks in people.

clue.text: Open with bad round right away

indicators.note: bad as in spoilt, so the letters are jumbled
the right letter is taken away from round

explanation.surface: Starting with a bad round, the golfer is right out of it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'away' takes R from ROUND to leave OUND, which 'bad' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: To unfasten or unwrap is to open.

clue.text: Nose no longer running, easing off?

definitions.meaning: nose-wiping finished, the honking done with

explanation.definitionFit: A storm that is passing is dying down, and a finished nose-blow is also over.
